prompt: Complete ShipmentNotifier, a service that is HANDED its EventLog through the constructor and delegates every message to it. A delay of 0 days or fewer must record nothing at all.
explanation: Constructor injection means the collaborator arrives from outside instead of being created inside the class, so the class depends on the EventLog interface rather than on any particular log. That is what lets the test pass in a capturing fake and read back exactly what was recorded. The notifier composes the log -- it HAS an EventLog -- and its own counters stay per-instance while the injected log can be shared.
hints: Store the constructor argument in a private field; every method that needs to say something calls log.record(...) instead of printing.
delay() should return early when days <= 0, before it touches the counter or the log.
The counters are ordinary instance fields; summary() just reads them, it must not record a line.
